typography.font_strategy: JetBrains Mono MUST be used for all numerical data, odds, percentages, tickers, and Kelly stakes. Chivo for section headers (often uppercase, tracking-widest). IBM Plex Sans for general body text and interface labels.

colors.rules: ABSOLUTELY NO PURPLE OR TEAL. No gradients unless functional (like a heat map). Colors are purely for data signaling.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Control Room Grid. Base grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 with tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-px with border-collapse approach).
spacing_and_layout.padding: Compact density. p-4 or p-6 for panels. Minimal white space, maximize data density.
spacing_and_layout.borders: Expose the grid. Use 1px solid borders (border-[#262626]) extensively to separate data points. Do not rely on whitespace alone.
spacing_and_layout.radius: rounded-none globally. Extreme sharp edges for terminal feel.

components_strategy.cards: Flat background (surface), 1px solid border. NO SHADOWS. Hover effect: change border color to border-focus and background to surface_hover.
components_strategy.buttons: Primary: Solid #F5F5F5 bg, black text, rounded-none. Secondary: border-border border solid, transparent bg. Hover: invert or highlight.
components_strategy.tabs: Minimalist. Underline indicators or solid stark blocks. Avoid pill shapes. Text should be uppercase mono.
components_strategy.tables: Dense. text-sm or text-xs mono. py-2 px-3 cells. Explicit bottom borders. Hover states on rows.
components_strategy.badges: Square borders, uppercase mono text. Used for Risk levels, EV score flags, etc.
components_strategy.charts: Recharts. Monochrome axes and grids. Use signal green/red ONLY for the actual data lines/bars to draw extreme attention.

feature_execution.daily_picks_board: Grid of dense cards. Key data (Odds, EV, Confidence) must be huge JetBrains Mono numbers. Clear visual split between Match Info and AI Analysis.
feature_execution.consensus_meter: Segmented horizontal bar chart. Left side (Claude) white, Right side (GPT) dark grey. Center line indicates alignment.
feature_execution.roi_tracking: Sharp line chart (Recharts). Area under the line should be a faint 5% opacity signal green.
feature_execution.live_analytics: Implement a continuously scrolling marquee (react-fast-marquee) for live line movements or sharp money alerts at the very top or bottom of the dashboard.
feature_execution.filter_rejection_log: Terminal-style list. Dimmed text (text-tertiary) for rejected matches, with a mono red tag for 'TRAP' or 'LOW_EV'.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Background lightens slightly (surface -> surface_hover). Data rows might gain a 1px left-border of signal green on hover.

icons_and_media.icon_style: weight='bold' or 'fill'. Keep them small and functional.

images.description: Abstract dark terminal texture, deep obsidian black background with faint 1px grid lines. Use sparingly for auth backgrounds or empty states.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive elements, forms, tabs, and key data nodes MUST include data-testid. Format: kebab-case, role-based (e.g., 'picks-tab-button', 'consensus-meter', 'roi-chart').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI but aggressively override styles to remove all border-radius (rounded-none).
Ensure all backgrounds are #050505 or #121212. DO NOT use Shadcn's default slate or zinc which have blue/purple undertones. Override global CSS variables strictly to grayscale/neutral.
Assemble the dashboard prioritizing data visibility. It should look like a professional trading interface, not a consumer web app.
Use mock data that reflects sports betting reality (e.g., fractional/decimal odds, team names, sharp money percentages).
